name: Sachin Chavan
player_statement:
A complete player, Sachin Chavan has made a big mark in cricket. With 3 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 13, with an average of 15.50 and a quick strike rate of 172.22. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 1 sixes and 5 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 9.2 overs, taking 6 wickets at an economy rate of 3.64. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
